mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 (thousands of units) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicate an overheating economy with tightening monetary policy, triggering equity sell-offs as recession risks escalate over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 108.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 3.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1250.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 520000.0) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 255.0), rising inflation signals potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high-inflation periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
